profileLabel: Liberal-leaning social values (medium confidence); democratic institutions slightly negative (low confidence)
summary: Bulacan 4th District representative with 76 principal-authored bills. Authored Family Code equality for women and men, violence against women in politics, technology-facilitated violence against women, gender-responsive national laws, crisis centers for women and children, women's participation in political parties, civil registration reform and a postponement of the barangay and SK elections.
caveat: Democratic score rests on one election-postponement filing offset by a party-participation bill. Bill-based; no votes.

economic.label: Insufficient evidence
economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
